一个连接，使用多家模型: Multiple model providers in one connection
自定义连接 · 兼容接口或本地服务: Custom connection · Compatible or local API
选择你要使用的服务，下一步填写连接凭证。: Choose a service, then enter its credentials.
可以通过下方的“其他服务”填写连接地址。: Use Other services below to enter a custom endpoint.
默认使用国内站 API；其他区域可在自定义设置中修改地址。: Uses the China API by default. Change the endpoint under Custom settings for other regions.
默认使用北京地域的按量 API；其他地域或套餐请按接入文档修改地址。: Uses the pay-as-you-go API in Beijing by default. See the setup guide for other regions or plans.
默认使用国内站的按量 API；Coding Plan 请按接入文档修改地址。: Uses the China pay-as-you-go API by default. See the setup guide for the Coding Plan endpoint.
新会话默认使用，会话中可随时切换。: Used for new conversations. Switch at any time.
留空自动识别名称。: Leave blank to use the detected name.
未识别的能力暂不开启。服务未提供信息时，可根据其说明手动设置。: Unknown capabilities stay off. Use the provider’s documentation to configure them manually.
自动适配，通常无需修改: Detected automatically; usually no changes needed
通常留空，由应用与服务自动处理。: Usually leave these blank for the app and provider to manage.
单位为 tokens，包含思考和正文。留空自动分配。: In tokens, including reasoning and the answer. Leave blank for automatic allocation.
留空使用服务默认值。: Leave blank to use the provider default.
自动识别名称、图片、思考和长度规格；未识别的项目可在添加后核对。: Names, image input, reasoning and token limits are detected automatically. Review unknown capabilities after adding.
选择要使用的模型，能力信息将一并保存。: Select models to use. Their detected capabilities will be saved too.
识别结果已过期，请重新获取模型信息。: Detection results have expired. Fetch model information again.
连接已变更，请重新获取模型信息。: The connection has changed. Fetch model information again.
密钥已变更，请重新获取模型信息。: The key has changed. Fetch model information again.
目录之外的模型需要配置 API 类型和地址。: Models outside the catalog require an API protocol and base URL.
不同会话可以同时生成，同一会话按顺序处理。等待你的回答时不占用请求名额。: Conversations can generate together; turns within each conversation stay in order. Waiting for your answer uses no request slot.
所有服务连接合计最多同时请求的数量。: Maximum simultaneous requests across all connections.
每个服务连接各自计算，主模型、Writer、子代理和总结合用。: Counted separately for each connection and shared by the main model, Writer, subagents, and summaries.
超出名额的请求自动等待。提高上限会立即放行；降低上限会等待已有请求结束，不中断生: Extra requests wait automatically. Raising a limit starts waiting requests; lowering it lets current requests finish.
%{name} 已排队，等待请求名额: %{name} is queued, waiting for a request slot
并发请求数必须是 1 到 32 之间的整数。: Concurrent requests must be an integer from 1 to 32.
并发设置已经更新，请刷新后再保存。: Concurrency settings have changed. Refresh before saving.
保存的并发设置无法读取，请检查数据库或从备份恢复。: Saved concurrency settings could not be read. Check the database or restore a backup.
默认从 JSON 读取，也可以使用已授权的其他项目。: Read from the JSON by default. You can also use another authorized project.
填写 global 或模型支持的区域，例如 us-central1。: Enter global or a region supported by your model, such as us-central1.
留空保留当前服务账号。填写或导入新的 JSON 可替换。: Leave blank to keep the current service account. Paste or import new JSON to replace it.
粘贴 Google Cloud 服务账号密钥 JSON，或从文件导入。凭证加密保: Paste Google Cloud service account key JSON or import a file. Credentials are encrypted and never shared with model tools.
服务账号 JSON 不能超过 32 KB。: Service account JSON must not exceed 32 KB.
请输入服务账号 JSON 对象。: Enter a service account JSON object.
JSON 类型必须为 service_account，请使用 Google Cl: The JSON type must be service_account. Use a service account key downloaded from Google Cloud.
服务账号 JSON 需要 project_id、client_email 和 p: Service account JSON requires project_id, client_email, and private_key.
服务账号 JSON 缺少有效的 project_id。: Service account JSON is missing a valid project_id.
服务账号 JSON 缺少有效的 client_email。: Service account JSON is missing a valid client_email.
服务账号 JSON 缺少有效的 private_key。: Service account JSON is missing a valid private_key.
服务账号 JSON 的 private_key_id 不正确。: The service account private_key_id is invalid.
服务账号 private_key 不是有效的 RSA 私钥。: The service account private_key is not a valid RSA private key.
仅支持 Google Cloud 官方服务账号和令牌地址。: Only official Google Cloud service accounts and token endpoints are supported.
无法读取 JSON 文件，请重新选择或粘贴内容。: Unable to read the JSON file. Select it again or paste its contents.
Vertex AI 需要服务账号 JSON，不能填写 API 密钥。: Vertex AI requires service account JSON rather than an API key.
请在 Google Cloud Vertex AI 连接中导入服务账号 JSON: Import service account JSON in a Google Cloud Vertex AI connection.
Google Cloud 未返回有效的访问令牌。: Google Cloud did not return a valid access token.
Google Cloud 认证超时，请稍后重试。: Google Cloud authentication timed out. Try again later.
Google Cloud 认证失败，请检查服务账号 JSON、密钥状态和服务器时: Google Cloud authentication failed. Check the service account JSON, key status, and server clock.
模型认证方式不受支持。: This model authentication method is not supported.
Vertex AI 需要匹配项目和区域的 Google Cloud 官方地址及: Vertex AI requires the official Google Cloud endpoint for the project and location, using Chat Completions.
Vertex AI 模型 ID 格式不正确，请填写 Google 模型 ID。: Invalid Vertex AI model ID. Enter a Google model ID.
模型认证方式必须与服务连接一致。: Model authentication must match the service connection.
切换认证方式时需要重新填写凭证或移除当前密钥。: Enter new credentials or remove the current key when changing authentication methods.
Vertex AI 请手动填写 Google 模型 ID，然后使用测试模型检查访: Enter a Google model ID manually for Vertex AI, then use Test model to check access.
请为项目启用 Vertex AI API，并授予服务账号相应的模型调用权限。: Enable the Vertex AI API for the project and grant the service account permission to invoke the model.
Vertex AI 请填写当前项目和区域可用的 Google 模型 ID。添加后: Enter a Google model ID available in this project and location. You can test access after adding it.
每行一个 ID；可以带 google/ 前缀。: One ID per line; the google/ prefix is optional.
